products.verdict: A mainstream business-monitor option for a tidy USB-C desk setup. Compare it directly with the U2723QE and confirm the exact charging wattage for your region and laptop.
products.sourceNote: Dell's official P2723QE datasheet lists 27-inch 4K 60Hz, IPS, USB-C hub, and height/tilt/swivel/pivot stand adjustment.

guides.title: Best Thunderbolt and USB-C Docking Stations for Laptop Setups: US & UK Guide
guides.summary: A specification-led guide to laptop docking stations, comparing host connectivity, display support, charging power, ports and operating-system limitations.
guides.introduction: Choose a dock only after checking the laptop's exact USB-C capabilities. USB-C connector shape alone does not guarantee Thunderbolt, USB4, video output or high-wattage charging. Multi-monitor support also depends on the computer's processor, graphics architecture and operating system. Confirm the exact model revision and regional power supply before buying. This guide is based on manufacturer documentation, not hands-on testing.
guides.editorialStatus: Research draft — requires human review before publication.

products.name: CalDigit TS4 Thunderbolt 4 Dock
products.bestFor: Thunderbolt laptop users who need a large range of ports, 2.5Gb Ethernet and high host charging power.
pros: Thunderbolt 4 host connection with up to 98W host power delivery
Large port selection including three Thunderbolt 4, three USB-C, five USB-A, DisplayPort 1.4 and UHS-II SD/microSD readers
2.5 Gigabit Ethernet and separate audio connections
cons: Requires a compatible Thunderbolt/USB4 or supported USB-C host for full functionality
Display count and resolution depend on the computer and its graphics/display pipeline
A premium multi-port dock may be unnecessary for users who only need a few USB peripherals
products.verdict: A strong connectivity-focused candidate for a fixed workstation with many peripherals and wired networking. Check CalDigit's host compatibility guidance and monitor limits for the exact laptop.
products.sourceNote: CalDigit's official TS4 support page lists its port inventory, 98W host power delivery, 2.5Gb Ethernet and minimum system requirements.

products.name: Anker Prime TB5 Docking Station (14-in-1)
products.bestFor: Newer Thunderbolt 5 laptops and demanding desk setups that can benefit from high-bandwidth connectivity and up to 140W host charging.
pros: Thunderbolt 5 upstream connection with up to 140W maximum power delivery
Two downstream Thunderbolt 5 ports, 2.5Gb Ethernet, HDMI 2.1 or DisplayPort 2.1 output, SD and TF card readers
Designed for high-bandwidth workflows and multiple connected devices
cons: Full Thunderbolt 5 benefits require a compatible host computer and peripherals
The HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 2.1 outputs are selectable rather than simultaneous according to the listed port specification
Check the exact display modes and macOS/Windows compatibility for the laptop before purchase

products.name: Kensington SD5780T Thunderbolt 4 Dock

HDMI 2.1, two downstream Thunderbolt 4 ports, UHS-II SD reader and 2.5Gb Ethernet
